document.about: True Manufacturing T-49-HC reach-in refrigerator spec sheet (2 pages). Its dimensions are mixed numbers typeset with no space before the fraction, three ways: the font's own fraction figures in the text and the table, a numerator set smaller and raised in the drawing, and halves the font draws whole.

notes: 2026-11-23: each mixed number read as one number, its fraction joined to the whole number: 223/8"D for 22 3/8"D (#46). The drawing's raised numerators read as powers: 78⁵/16".

checks.issue: The font's fraction figures, the same size as the text, joined the whole number: 249/16"L x 223/8"D.
As above, in the dimensions table: 541/8 1375.
The drawing sets each numerator smaller and raised, and it read as a power: 78⁵/16".
The font draws ½ as one glyph whose text is 1/2, and it joined the 2 before it: 21/2” stem castors.
No whole number takes its fraction's numerator.
